s: Which of the following statements is false about Damodaram Sanjeevaiah?
o: He was never defeated in the elections
He was the second Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh
He was the President of the Indian National Congress
He served as a minister of Andhra Pradesh
x:
Damodaram Sanjivayya was the second Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh (1960– 1962) and the first Dalit Chief Minister of any Indian State. He later became the President of the Indian National Congress (1962–1964) and also served as a Union Minister. The statement that he was never defeated in an election is incorrect, as he did suffer electoral defeats during his political career.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
